Name: Seaside Sounds
Author: witchtopia
Description:
[size=5]🌊 [b]WELCOME TO SEASIDE SOUNDS![/b] 🎶[/size]

The Stardew Valley beach is beautiful, but sometimes the sound of the waves alone leaves things feeling a little [i]too[/i] quiet.

[b]Seaside Sounds[/b] adds a gentle, island-inspired music loop to the coastal corners of Pelican Town, giving the Beach and its neighboring interiors a little more musical life without sacrificing Stardew Valley’s environmental ambience. 🐚✨

A little music for fishing, shopping, and bothering Elliott while he’s trying to finish his novel.

[center]🌊━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━🌊[/center]

[size=4]✨ [b]MOD FEATURES[/b] ✨[/size]

🏖️ [b]Music at the Beach![/b]
Adds a mellow coastal background track while you fish, forage, wander the shore, or contemplate whether you really need another 37 pieces of coral.

🪶 [b]Music inside Elliott’s Cabin![/b]
The seaside soundtrack follows you indoors, so Elliott can finally write his novel with some proper background music.

🎣 [b]Music inside Willy’s Fish Shop![/b]
Buy bait, upgrade your fishing rod, and listen to something other than the quiet judgment of several mounted fish.

🌊 [b]Vanilla ambience stays intact![/b]
Seaside Sounds keeps its music separate from Stardew Valley’s environmental audio, so waves, weather, and other ambient sound effects can continue playing normally alongside the soundtrack.

🎶 [b]One shared seaside soundscape![/b]
The Beach, Elliott’s Cabin, and Willy’s Fish Shop all use the same track, giving Pelican Town’s little coastal corner its own musical identity.

🪶 [b]Lightweight and simple![/b]
No Custom Music framework required! Seaside Sounds uses Stardew Valley’s native audio system through Content Patcher.

[center]🌊━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━🌊[/center]

[size=4]🐚 [b]WHERE DOES IT PLAY?[/b] 🐚[/size]

Seaside Sounds currently adds music to:

🏖️ [b]The Beach[/b]

🪶 [b]Elliott’s Cabin[/b]

🎣 [b]Willy’s Fish Shop[/b]

Whether you’re fishing from the shore, buying tackle from Willy, or walking into Elliott’s house completely uninvited, the music follows Pelican Town’s seaside atmosphere indoors. 🌊

[center]🌊━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━🌊[/center]

[size=4]🎵 [b]THE MUSIC[/b] 🎵[/size]

Seaside Sounds uses: [b]“Feel Good Island Loop”[/b]

🎼 Original music by [b]Brandon Morris[/b]

🔁 Loop edit/upload by [b]AntumDeluge[/b]

The track is a mellow instrumental featuring piano, marimba, bass, and percussion, chosen to complement Stardew Valley’s relaxed coastal atmosphere without overpowering the game.

The music is available under [b]CC0 1.0 Universal[/b], allowing it to be copied, modified, redistributed, performed, and used commercially. Attribution isn’t required under CC0, but the original creators are credited here because they deserve their flowers. 🌺

[center]🌊━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━🌊[/center]

[size=4]🎥 [b]STREAMER FRIENDLY[/b] 🎥[/size]

The music included with Seaside Sounds is available under [b]CC0[/b], meaning it is licensed for commercial use, redistribution, and monetized content such as YouTube videos and livestreams. ✨

Automated copyright systems can occasionally decide they know better than the actual license, so no audio can be guaranteed completely immune from an incorrect Content ID claim. However, the CC0 license provides clear permission for commercial use, modification, and redistribution.

[center]🌊━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━🌊[/center]

[size=4]📥 [b]HOW TO INSTALL[/b] 📥[/size]

You’ll need:

🌱 [b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b]

🔧 [b]SMAPI[/b]

🧩 [b]Content Patcher[/b]

[b]🔊 Positional Audio[/b]

Once those are installed, extract [b]Seaside Sounds[/b] into your Stardew Valley [b]Mods[/b] folder and launch the game through SMAPI.

Then head down to the shore and enjoy your newly musical beachfront. 🌊🎶

[center]🌊━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━🌊[/center]

[size=4]🧩 [b]COMPATIBILITY NOTES[/b] 🧩[/size]

Seaside Sounds changes the music behavior for:

🏖️ [b]Beach[/b]

🪶 [b]ElliottHouse[/b]

🎣 [b]FishShop[/b]

It does [b]not[/b] modify maps, NPCs, schedules, shops, dialogue, fishing, weather, or other gameplay systems.

Because the added music and environmental ambience are handled separately, vanilla weather sounds can continue playing alongside the soundtrack. 🌧️🌊🎵

Mods that also change the music assigned to these locations may override Seaside Sounds or be overridden by it depending on how they’re loaded.

Compatibility patch requests are welcome! 💕
